# pxc_vlselect_auth (Data Source)

Fetches a proxmox cloud secret, scoped by target_pve, from the postgres px_cloud_secret table.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `mc_peers` (Set of String) List of peers to look for vlselect auth via their multi cloud gateway.
- `mc_token` (String) Multi cloud token to query the other peers.

### Read-Only

- `vlselect_auth_password` (String) The fetched password, either from local or from multi cloud peers.
